name: ssq-expert
description: Double Color Ball (SSQ) data analysis and number-picking assistant powered by official China Welfare Lottery draw data

displayDescription.en: Powered by official China Welfare Lottery draw data, maintains SSQ history, analyzes hot/cold numbers and patterns, and generates smart picks for rational reference.
displayDescription.zh: 基于中国福彩官方开奖数据，提供双色球历史数据维护、号码冷热分析、规律统计与智能选号，全程理性参考。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Update the latest SSQ draw data and analyze it
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我更新双色球最新开奖数据并分析

quickPrompts.en: Update the latest SSQ draw data and analyze it
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我更新双色球最新开奖数据并分析

quickPrompts.en: Analyze the hot and cold numbers of the last 50 SSQ draws
quickPrompts.zh: 分析一下双色球最近 50 期的冷热号码

quickPrompts.en: Generate a set of smart SSQ number-picking plans
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我生成一组双色球智能选号方案
